title: Zephaniah Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Zephaniah 1: the word that came to Zephaniah, the great day of Yahweh, and silver that cannot deliver.

questions.text: Zephaniah is called the son of whom?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:1 says Yahweh's word came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi.

questions.text: In the days of which king did Yahweh's word come to him?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:1 says it came in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

questions.text: Besides man and animal, what does Yahweh say he will sweep away?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:3 says he will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked.

answers.text: The cedars and the vines of the land
The birds of the sky and the fish of the sea
The gold and the silver of the city
The chariots and the horses of war

questions.text: Against whom does Yahweh say he will stretch out his hand in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:4 says he will stretch out his hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

answers.text: Moab and the children of Ammon
Nineveh and the land of Assyria
Gaza and the cities of the coast
Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem

questions.text: What do those on the housetops worship, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:5 speaks of those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops.

questions.text: Why are they told to be silent at the presence of the Lord Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:7 says to be silent, for the day of Yahweh is at hand and Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice.

answers.text: Because the day of Yahweh is at hand

questions.text: With what does Yahweh say he will search Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:12 says he will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men who are settled on their dregs.

questions.text: What does verse 13 say about the houses they build?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:13 says they will build houses but won't inhabit them, and plant vineyards but won't drink their wine.

answers.text: They will be full of silver

questions.text: How is that day described in verse 15?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:15 calls it a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of darkness and gloom.

answers.text: A day of wrath and anguish
A day of feasting and gladness
A day of rain and harvest
A day of silence and rest

questions.text: What will not be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh's wrath?
questions.explanation: Zephaniah 1:18 says neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in that day.
